title: $p$-adic properties of division polynomials and algebraic sigma functions
summary: Let $p \geq 5$ be a prime, let $K$ be a finite extension of $\mathbb{Q}_p$, and let $E/K$ be an elliptic curve with good reduction. Let $F_n$ denote the $n$-division polynomial of $E$. Silverman proved that if the reduction is ordinary, then for every $P \in E(K) \setminus \hat{E}(K)$ and a suitable power $q$ of $p$, the sequences $(F_{mq^k}(P))_{k \geq 0}$ converge $p$-adically to limits that are algebraic over the field of definition of $E$.
